<!-- lang: en-US -->
- Fixed settings popups not closing when their buttons were clicked again.
- Kept the usage panel layout consistent when switching between app pages, quota pages and groups.
- Reduced flicker in the collapsed view when switching songs in QQ Music, with smoother cover transitions and more reliable song title notices.

<!-- lang: zh-CN -->
- 修復再次點選設定按鈕時，彈窗無法關閉的問題。
- 修復切換應用分頁、配額分頁和分組時，用量面板佈局變化的問題。
- 改善 QQ 音樂切歌時收起面板的閃動、封面切換和歌曲名稱提示。
